mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Fireman's Park, and if you are an early riser, the International Space Station will be visible at 4:14 AM tomorrow. It will rise in the northwest over the high school area and move toward the northeast near Home Depot, remaining low near the horizon. Expect an overnight low of 67 degrees with no rain predicted.

City Hall has announced several important proclamations. September is now officially Hunger Action Month to address food insecurity for 1 in 8 residents in Southwest Wisconsin, and September is also Suicide Prevention Month. Additionally, today is Building Inspector and Code Staff Appreciation Day to thank our local safety guardians. On the roads, please note that flagging on Highway M continues for utility work, which may cause some travel delays.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers' Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon kicks off at the high school, and there is a Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness on August 31, or test your knowledge at trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee starting September 1.

Regarding the weekly police report, on August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and cited the driver for possession of marijuana after detecting the odor of the substance in the vehicle.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:30 PM, and today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. Be sure to stop by before they close tonight to enjoy a delicious treat.
